stageMeta.title: Web Access
headerComment: # Stage 12 — Web Access
# L12 = L11 + Web access.  Every plugin from Stage 06 is still here —
# sandbox, approval, FS, shell, search, persistence, resume — plus the
# accumulated closures of L7..L11 (stateful tasks, multi-agent, workflow,
# operability, product config), and now the web capability seam:
#   dsh-web                 ctx.web seam: the WebRuntime service itself —
#                           provider registries for search and fetch plus
#                           order-independent provider selection and the
#                           WebError taxonomy
#   dsh-web-search-deepseek search provider "deepseek-official": native
#                           web_search over DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible
#                           Messages API ({baseURL}/messages)
#   dsh-tool-web            consumer: the model-facing web_search and
#                           web_fetch tools (inject tools/web/systemPrompt)
#   dsh-web-fetch-http    fetch provider: plain HTTP GET with size and
#                           content-type limits, no browser required
#                           the DeepSeek-native provider, fetch via plain
# This is the first level where the model can leave the local environment.
# Everything before L12 — files, shell, subagents, workflows — acted on the
# host; web_search reaches the public internet.
# Architecture concept: the seam is NOT an abstract class this time.
# Unlike dsh-jobs / dsh-compaction / dsh-settings (abstract seams whose
# provider extends the base and re-registers the same service name, so
# the abstract entry stays disabled), dsh-web IS the runtime: providers
# register INTO ctx.web via registerSearchProvider/registerFetchProvider
# and never claim the "web" service name, so all three entries mount
# enabled.  With exactly one usable search provider registered, selection
# auto-resolves — no searchProvider config needed.
# Headless notes:
#   - One web_search call costs a FULL auxiliary DeepSeek model turn (the
#     provider asks a separate model to perform the search with the native
#     web_search_20250305 server tool), not a cheap retrieval request —
#     watch the web/deepseek-search-llm-request session event in --trace.
#   - The auxiliary request speaks the Anthropic Messages protocol, so it
#     reuses this repo's gateway route: baseURL falls back to $QA_BASE_URL
#     and the credential reference is QA_API_KEY, resolved per search
#     through ctx.credentials (L11) with the process env as its layer.
#   - Web tools bypass the L6 approval gate entirely (the package defines
#     no web-specific permission policy), so in a headless run web access
#     is unmediated — the only brakes are searchMaxResults/searchMaxQueries
#     and the 30s cooperative tool-call budget.
# The persona is frozen (byte-for-byte identical to L4/L5/L6) so the whole
# L4→L12 progression remains a single-variable experiment.
stageMeta.driverQuestion: Use the web_search tool to find what the current Node.js LTS release is (version number and release date). Report the answer and cite the source URLs as markdown links.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web
comments: # ctx.web, the web capability seam.  NOT an abstract contract in the
# dsh-jobs sense: WebRuntime extends Service and is mounted directly —
# providers register into it instead of replacing it, so there is no
# service-name conflict and nothing to keep disabled.  No config: with
# exactly one usable search provider the selection auto-resolves

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # Search provider "deepseek-official" (inject: [web]).  Each search is a
    # complete Anthropic Messages call carrying the native web_search_20250305
    # server tool — the gateway already speaks anthropic-messages for the
    # conversation model, so the same route serves the auxiliary one:
    # baseURL falls back to $QA_BASE_URL (/messages is appended), and the
    # key reference is QA_API_KEY, resolved per search through ctx.credentials
    # (L11) so a rotated key reaches the next call.  Defaults kept: model
    # deepseek-v4-flash, apiVersion 2023-06-01, maxTokens 4096, maxUses 5.
    apiKeyEnv: QA_API_KEY
    baseURL: !!js process.env.QA_BASE_URL ?? 'https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1'

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http
comments: # HTTP fetch provider for the same ctx.web seam (inject [web]).
# Now web_fetch has a real backend — plain HTTP GET with size
# and content-type limits, no browser required.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web
entries.configYaml:
config:
    # Model-facing consumer (inject: [tools, web, systemPrompt] — all
    # @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http is not installed at this level, and an
    # enabled-but-providerless tool stays visible only to fail every call
    # with WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE — disabling keeps the model contract
    # honest (search guidance then omits the fetch follow-up).  Defaults
    # kept: searchMaxResults 8, searchMaxQueries 4, searchTimeoutMs 30000.
